title: Wood structures

# Wood structures

# Introduction

Wood structures are the first set of structures available to the player, requiring wood and the proximity of a workbench to be built and repaired.

## Common properties

Wood structures share the following properties:
The 2m beam, 26° beam and 45° beam are an exception and use the resistances of stone structures. This is not the case for the 1m beam.

• Property: Durability | Value: 400

• Property: Support | Value: Wood (from 10 to 100)

• Property: Loss | Value: 1/8 vertical, 1/5 horizontal

• Property: Resistances | Value: Weak: Chop Neutral: Blunt, Slash, Pickaxe, Fire, Frost, Lightning Resistant: Pierce Immune: Poison, Spirit

### Floors and stairs

• Structure: Wood floor 1x1 | Materials: Wood x1 | Size: 1x0.13x1 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Wood floor 2x2 | Materials: Wood x2 | Size: 2x0.13x2 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Wood stair | Materials: Wood x2 | Size: 2x2x1 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Wood ladder | Materials: Wood x2 | Size: 1x2x2 | Damaged by rain: Yes
